description: Defines the ManufacturerDescription entity class, which extends Description, representing manufacturer descriptions with additional attributes such as URL, click count, and last click date. It relates to the Manufacturer entity and is mapped to the MANUFACTURER_DESCRIPTION table in the SALESMANAGER schema.

classes.name: ManufacturerDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing manufacturer descriptions with URL, click metrics, and last click date, associated with a Manufacturer.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the manufacturer description.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the manufacturer description.

methods.name: getUrlClicked
methods.description: Returns the number of times the URL was clicked.

methods.name: setUrlClicked
methods.description: Sets the number of URL clicks.

methods.name: getDateLastClick
methods.description: Returns the date of the last click on the URL.

methods.name: setDateLastClick
methods.description: Sets the date of the last click.
